 Monday, November 16, 2026 | Men's Basketball, Chris Harry
 Share: By: Chris Harry, Senior Writer 
 No. 1 Florida vs. Notre Dame
 What: The Players Era 8 
 When: Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday 
 Where:  Michelob ULTRA Arena / Las Vegas
 Who: Florida (4-0) vs Notre Dame (4-0), with six other teams competiting over the three days for the tournament title.

 The Setup
 No. 1 Florida and Notre Dame meet in opening-round play of the Players Era 8, an eight-team event with all participants playing three games over three days. Both UF and ND are unbeaten through four games, with the Gators' last outing Friday's 83-54 home win against Merrimack. The Fighting Irish defeated South Carolina State 99-59 on their home floor Wednesday at South Bend, Indiana. Remarkably, the two programs have never played in men's basketball.
 The first-round schedule looks like this (all times Eastern): No. 8 Houston (3-0) vs. Rutgers (3-0), 2 p.m. / No. 1 UF (4-0) vs Notre Dame (4-0), 4:30 p.m. / No. 11 Kansas vs UNLV (3-0), 9:30 p.m. / West Virginia (3-0) vs. Auburn (2-1), Wednesday at 12 a.m. The Gators, result pending, will be paired against the winner or loser of the Houston-Rutgers game Wednesday at either 2 or 4:30 p.m. The tournament championship game is scheduled for Thursday at 11 p.m. It's possible, Florida could play two of the nation's top four KenPom.com teams here, as Houston is No. 3 and Kansas is No. 4 (with a home date against Duke, currently No. 2) two weeks away. Yes, this event is a Quad 1 bonanza, relative to the NCAA Evaluation Tool (NET) that ultiimately will seed the NCAA Tournament.
 Each participating team gets $1 million that is dedicated to the respective program's Name, Image and Likeness (NIL) fund. 
 Michelob ULTRA Arena (capacity xxxx) at the Mandalay Bay resort is home to the WNBA Las Vegas Aces.

 The Breakdown 
 Notre Dame point guard Braeden Smith 
 About the Gators
 They remain atop the KenPom rankings, with two players, forwards Thomas Haugh (2nd) and Alex Condon (5th), appearing in the site's Player of the Year standings. The Gators are one of only three teams (along with Duke and Michigan State) ranked in the top 10 in both offensive and defensive efficiency. Notre Dame will be UF's third opponent in five games ranked in the KenPom  top 75. The other seven teams in the field have played one such team. 
 Condon (16 points, 6 rebounds, 4 assists) and Haugh (15 points, 6 rebounds) led the way in the team's win over Merrimack, with center Rueben Chinyelu (12 points, 6 rebounds) his normal force inside on both ends. None of the "Big Three" played more than 25 minutes in the game, so they should be well rested for the tournament and its grueling schedule. Chinyelu is shooting a team-high 68% from the floor, with Condon at 55.6 and Haugh at 52.6, including 45% from the 3-point line. UF's veteran frontcourt figures to have a significant size advantage and experience advantage on its Irish counterpart.  
 Point guard Boogie Fland was held out of the Merrimack game with a sore shoulder from a collision in the second half of UF's win Nov. 10 at Florida State. Fland finished that game, but leftover aches led to rest. He is expected to play againsat ND. He's been very good at keeping the offense organized and even better with his on-ball defense in the halfcourt. With Fland out of the lineup, Denzel Aberdeen (3 points, 4 rebounds, 1 assist in 20 minutes) was quiet in taking most of the reps at point, but little-used sophomore Alex Lloyd was given the first start of his career and responded with career highs of 11 points and a trio of 3-pointers, potentially lengthening the UF bench as it inches toward Southeastern Conference play. 
 The Gators posted double-digit 3-pointers in their first two games at 43%, but have fallen off a tad at 33.3% over the last two games, with the front rotation guys just two of 10 against Merrmack. Where UF has excelled is at the free-throw line, where the Gators made 48 of their last 55 (87.3%) over the last three halves, including 21 of 22 against Merrimack that at 95.5% marked the best by a UF team this century when taking at least 20. The Gators shot 62.9% through the first two games. 
 The Florida bench, led by guard Urban Klavzar (9.8 ppg), wing Isaiah Brown (5.5 ppg) and forward Domen Petrovic (3.2 ppg) has outscored opponents in all four games and stands at an aggregate plus-55. Klavzar, however, is has just seven of his team-high 23 attempts from the 3-point line. His 30.4% from deep is a steep drop from 39.1% for his career, including 40.6% last season. Look for his percentages to start returning to the mean.  
 About the Fighting Irish
 They're in the fourth season under Micah Shrewsberry , who took over in 2023 following the retirement of Mike Brey, who left South Bend after winning 562 games and guiding Notre Dame to 13 NCAA tournaments over his 23 seasons. Shrewsberry came by way of Penn State, where he went 37-41 in two seasons, but bolted after guiding the Nittany Lions to the '23 tournament. In four seasons with the Irish, Shrewsberry is 82-87, without a winning record in three previous campaigns, plus a 19-39 mark in Atlantic Coast Conference play.
 The Irish opened the season with a 74-72 upset of Villanova in an historic, All-Catholic clash in Rome. Villanova currently sits at No. 39 in KenPom , but Notre Dame's three opponents since -- all home games -- are ranked in the nation's bottom 300: Mercyhurst (308), Eastern Illinois (362) and South Carolina State (335). The Irish won those games by an average margin of 30.3 points. 
 All five starters are averaging in double figures, with the team shooting better than 50% from the floor (50.4) and nearly 50 from the 3-point line (47.8). Wing Ethan Roberts , a transfer from Penn, is one of the most efficient players in the nation. His nearly 67% from the floor breaks down at 62.5% from the 2-point area and 68% from the 3-point line (17 of 25). Forward Brady Koehler is a top-60 defensive rebounder who has made 10 of 15 shots from the arc. Center Logan Duncomb , transfer from Winthrop, is a top-100 offensive rebounder who is making 81% of his attempts from the 2-point area. The coach's son, Braeden Shrewsberry , starts at the wing and is a dangerous 3-level scoring threat. 
 Point guard Braeden Smith , transfer from Gonzaga, has 29 assists, just four turnovers and is at 90.5% at the free-throw line. He also has 13 steals, which is only eight fewer than the entire UF team. He'll be a pest against UF's halfcourt offense.  
 Numbers of Note 
 UF forward Thomas Haugh  (10)  
 * .786  — UF coach Todd Golden 's winning percentage against ACC teams during his five seasons, based on an 11-3 record that includes two wins in as many tries this season.
 * 1  — Turnovers by Haugh this season, which is one less than the two double-doubles he's posted. The Gators as a team, though, sit at minus-1.8 in turnover margin, a statistic that definitely needs cleaning up. The Irish are plus-3.8 in that category.  
 * 2016  — The last year Notre Dame beat the nation's No. 1-ranked team. The Irish defeated top-ranked North Carolina 80-76 at South Bend. They are 7-23 all-time against No. 1, with their last crack a 100-56 home loss to Duke on Feb. 26, 2026.
 Bottom Line
We'll not only know a lot more about the Gators after this tournament, but a lot more about a lot of teams during a week with some really good games.
